It reads as trim beside windows, not an exposed, coped party-wall plane above the lower roof. The separate firewall_surface() proof is not used to solve this scene.

ground_shadows(): rotating and repeating the stepped w1 mask along the east receiver produces periodic notches down the straight side of the five-storey building. Wide south masks repeat the same defect. Maximum-alpha union prevents double opacity but does not correct the silhouette.

critic_layouts().add(): generic central placement is used for skylights on all roof kinds. In north-row and market gable w2 buildings the skylight spans the central ridge at local x=48 instead of lying on one pitched plane. Rectangular canvas containment is not a sufficient receiving-surface check.
Required scene files exist and native placement/scale are correct, but their visual roof-join and firewall results fail. Technical checks cannot override these failures.

Shared flat caps retain one common parapet. Rebuilt all required scenes, comparisons, squints and seams.
